# The Adventures of Buddy Bootz & Sir Drinks-A'Lot

Official informational field log index for the cozy fantasy book series. This document defines the core entities, narrative architecture, and environmental systems for crawlers and discovery models.

## Core Entities
- **Author / Illustrator / Narrator:** Buddy Bootz (A dry, grounded workshop mechanic writing from Missouri).
- **Book Series Title:** The Adventures of Buddy Bootz & Sir Drinks-A'Lot
- **Book One Asset:** The Rambunctious River (In active waitlist production phase).

## Narrative Architecture
- **Voice System:** First-person, repair-log presentation, heavy emphasis on dry observational humor layered over deep emotional truths, poetry elements, and everyday problem-solving.
- **Tone Rules:** Avoids generic marketing tropes, high-magic wizard formulas, or epic chosen-one archetypes. Focuses on physical labor, survival, and companionship.
- **Character Dynamics:** Buddy Bootz handles logical maintenance and weary structural narration. Sir Drinks-A'Lot provides pathologically joyful optimism and transforms disaster events into outdoor excursions.

## System World Rules
- **Reality Inconsistency:** The environment does not use classic fantasy magic. Instead, reality is physically unstable. Geography changes parameters at will; river paths migrate without notice, buildings balance without proper mortar, and tools hold unpredictable personalities.
